- [ ] **19. Criminal Revision Petition (BNSS §§438–445)** — §§ 438, 439, 440, 441, 442, 443, 444, 445 · For Appellate Correction · Forum: Sessions / High Court

- **For Forum:** HC transfer §447 · Sessions transfer §448 · Revision §§438–445
